title: 2007 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: At Frank’s Fruit Market, \(3\) bananas cost as much as \(2\) apples, and \(6\) apples cost as much as \(4\) oranges. How many oranges cost as much as \(18\) bananas?

solutions.text:
Since \(3\) bananas cost as much as \(2\) apples, \(18\) bananas cost as much as \(12\) apples.

Since \(6\) apples cost as much as \(4\) oranges, \(12\) apples cost as much as \(8\) oranges. Therefore \(18\) bananas cost as much as \(8\) oranges.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: First convert \(18\) bananas into an equivalent number of apples
Then convert those apples into oranges using \(6\) apples \(=4\) oranges
